issue.title: [test gap][dualtor] Validate the default route is received first before sending out any BGP updates

failure.body: Validate that, on a dualtor setup, after starting up a BGP session between T0 and T1, the T0 should receive the default route from the T1 first before sending out any BGP updates to the T1.

resolution.title: [dualtor] Add `test_dualtor_bgp_update_delay`

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Validate that after startup BGP sessions on the dualtor T0, the T0 will always sleep for 10 seconds before sending out BGP updates, so it could have BGP updates from peer T1s received earlier than any BGP updates from itself.

Signed-off-by: Longxiang Lyu <<EMAIL>>

#### How did you do it?
Add a new testcase `test_dualtor_bgp_update_delay`
